points: Boil a half-full kettle.
While it comes to the boil, halve the bell pepper and discard the core and seeds. Slice into thin strips.
Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ¼ tsp salt on high heat. Add the rice and cook for 12-13 mins.
Drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Get Started

points: While the rice cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on high heat.
Once hot, add the sliced pepper and stir-fry until softened and charred, 5-6 mins.
Meanwhile, peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Cut the lime into wedges.
steps.title: Fry Time

points: Once the pepper is charred, turn the heat down to medium, add the baby plum tomatoes and fry until starting to soften, 2-3 mins.
Next, add the garlic and Brazilian style spice mix. Fry for 30 secs.
Stir in the coconut milk, veg stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts).
steps.title: Add the Spice

points: Bring the sauce to the boil, then lower the heat.
Drain the prawns, then stir into the sauce.
Simmer until the sauce has thickened and the prawns are cooked through, 5-6 mins.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw prawns. They're cooked when pink on the outside and opaque in the middle

steps.title: Stir in the Prawns

points: While the prawns cook, roughly chop the coriander (stalks and all).
Once the prawns are cooked, squeeze in some lime juice, season with salt and pepper and remove from the heat.
Stir in half the coriander.
steps.title: Finishing Touches

points: Share the rice out between your bowls and spoon over the coconut prawn moqueca.
Sprinkle over the remaining coriander.
Serve any remaining lime wedges on the side for squeezing over.
steps.title: Serve
